title: The Sea Glass House
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The sea-glass house at the end of Crab Lane is always locked, and twelve-year-old Pip has always wondered why. When the summer's first storm washes a key onto the beach, Pip and her cousin Moe unlock a house full of sea-glass jars — each jar holding a note from a stranger, and one jar holding a note from Pip\'s missing grandmother.
